cells.zh: 公司制（自身上市）：B3普通股在自己管理的Novo Mercado板块挂牌交易
cells.en: Demutualized, listed on its own market (Novo Mercado governance segment)

cells.zh: 是：B3自身股票（代码B3SA3）在自己管理的市场上市，属于Novo Mercado治理板块——与港交所自身股票在自己主板挂牌的模式相同，都不同于NYSE「母公司反向在自己交易所上市」的结构
cells.en: Yes: B3's own shares (ticker B3SA3) are listed on its own market, in the Novo Mercado governance segment — the same direction as HKEX (self-listed on own main board), unlike NYSE where the parent company is listed on the exchange it doesn't itself trade on

cells.zh: 巴西雷亚尔 (BRL)
cells.en: BRL

cells.zh: 巴西证券交易委员会（Comissão de Valores Mobiliários, CVM）
cells.en: Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM)

cells.zh: BSM Supervisão de Mercados（B3集团旗下的自律监管子机构）
cells.en: BSM Supervisão de Mercados

cells.zh: 《6.385号法律》（Law 6385）——B3就非居民投资者事务列为核心巴西联邦证券法规之一
cells.en: Law No. 6.385 – listed by B3 as one of the core Brazilian federal securities statutes

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Call）：09:45–10:00为盘前阶段，只挂单不成交，用于形成开盘理论价格
cells.en: Opening Call: the 09:45–10:00 pre-opening phase accepts order entry without matching, used to form the theoretical opening price

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing Call）：16:55–17:00
cells.en: Closing Call: 16:55–17:00

cells.zh: 市价单、限价单、管理单（Managed Order）、竞争性管理单、自由裁量单（Discretionary Order）、联动单（Funding Order）、止损单（Stop Order）、配对单（Matched Order）八种基础类型；另有开盘市价单(MOA)、收盘市价单(MOC)、收盘限价单(LOC)等特殊撮合期订单，以及GTC/GTD等有效期修饰符
cells.en: Eight base order types: Market, Limit, Managed, Competing Managed, Discretionary, Funding, Stop, and Matched orders; plus auction-specific types Market-on-Auction (MOA), Market-on-Close (MOC), Limit-on-Close (LOC), and time-in-force qualifiers such as GTC/GTD

cells.zh: 动态「交易隧道」（trading tunnels）机制：以最新成交价/最优报价等推导出的基准价（PBT，tunnel base price）为中心，用加法或乘法方式计算带宽，动态限制申报价与成交价区间，而非固定百分比涨跌停
cells.en: Dynamic 'trading tunnels' mechanism: bands computed additively or multiplicatively around a tunnel base price (PBT) derived from the last trade price / best bid-ask, rather than a fixed daily percentage limit

cells.zh: 指数级熔断：以Ibovespa较前一交易日收盘的跌幅触发，分三档——跌10%暂停全市场交易30分钟；恢复后再跌15%暂停1小时；恢复后再跌20%由B3自行决定暂停时长并公告
cells.en: Index-level circuit breaker triggered by Ibovespa's decline from the prior close, in three stages: -10% halts all trading for 30 minutes; upon resumption, -15% halts trading for 1 hour; upon resumption, -20% lets B3 determine and announce the suspension period

cells.zh: 品种级的「拍卖隧道」（auction tunnel）机制：撮合价若将突破基于最近成交价动态计算的价格区间，系统不直接成交，而是自动触发一次集合竞价
cells.en: Instrument-level 'auction tunnel' mechanism: when a prospective trade price would breach the dynamically computed band around the last traded price, the system does not execute directly but automatically triggers an auction

cells.zh: T+0：允许当日回转交易（day trade）；B3自身税务页面把「Day trade」列为独立的操作类别，交易所层面未见限制次日才可卖出的规则
cells.en: T+0: same-day round-trip (day) trading is permitted; B3's own taxation page lists 'Day trade' as a distinct operation category, and no exchange-level rule requiring next-day resale was found

cells.zh: 存在证券出借/融券安排使做空成为可能（官网设「Securities Lending, Equity and ETF Trades」专栏），但本次抓取到的该页面正文只包含股票/ETF的代码、整手规格与结算周期，没有描述性正文说明具体限制规则（如是否有报升限制、裸卖空处理等），仅能确认功能入口存在
cells.en: A securities lending facility exists that enables short selling (the site has a page titled 'Securities Lending, Equity and ETF Trades'), but the content actually fetched on that page only covers ticker format, round-lot size and settlement period for stocks/ETFs — no descriptive text on specific restrictions (e.g. any uptick rule, treatment of naked short selling) was found; only the existence of the facility is confirmed

cells.zh: 分独立做市商、参与B3计划的独立做市商、受托做市商（Contracted Market Maker）三类注册；投资基金也可注册为独立做市商；获批后须在30日内开始履约，具体资产/衍生品可容纳的做市商数量上限由B3设定
cells.en: Three registration categories: independent market makers, independent market makers accredited for B3 programs, and contracted market makers; investment funds may also register as independent market makers; once approved, a market maker must begin acting within 30 days, and B3 caps the maximum number of market makers per asset/derivative

cells.zh: 发行人证券的挂牌/交易许可由B3依《发行人规则》（Issuer's Regulations）受理审核，另须完成CVM的「公众公司」注册；本次抓取到的页面未给出可直接归类为现有枚举值（注册制/核准制/混合制）的逐条描述，未强行套用枚举
cells.en: Admission of an issuer's securities to trading is handled by B3 under the Issuer's Regulations, alongside separate registration as a public company with CVM; the pages fetched this session did not provide text that cleanly maps to the existing review_system enum values (registration/approval/hybrid), so no enum value was forced

cells.zh: 退出治理板块（segment exit）或注销登记须发起强制公开要约收购（Public Tender Offer）；要约价格与最低受约比例因板块而异，例如Novo Mercado要求至少公允价格、且须获得至少1/3流通股股东接受
cells.en: Exiting a governance segment or deregistering requires a mandatory Public Tender Offer; the offer price and minimum acceptance threshold vary by segment — e.g. Novo Mercado requires at least fair value and acceptance by at least 1/3 of free-float shareholders

cells.zh: T+2（现货证券市场，2019年5月27日起从T+3缩短为T+2）
cells.en: T+2 (cash equities market; shortened from T+3, effective May 27, 2019)

cells.zh: B3 Clearinghouse（B3自身内设的中央对手方职能，非独立法人清算所）；外汇交易另由B3 Foreign Exchange Clearinghouse担任对手方
cells.en: B3 Clearinghouse (an in-house CCP function of B3 itself, not a separately incorporated clearing entity); FX trades are separately cleared by the B3 Foreign Exchange Clearinghouse

cells.zh: 分品种不同：现货证券市场为「资金+证券」过户交收（并非衍生品意义上的实物/现金交割二选一）；衍生品市场多数合约现金结算，但个股期货等部分合约存在实物交割
cells.en: Varies by instrument: the cash equities market settles via funds-versus-securities transfer (not a derivatives-style physical-vs-cash delivery choice); in the derivatives market most contracts are cash-settled, though some (e.g. single-stock futures) can involve physical delivery

cells.zh: 参与者分为全权交易参与者（Full Trading Participant, PNP）、交易参与者（Trading Participant, PN）与结算参与者（Settlement Participant, PL）三类，须通过LINE系统对客户设定交易前限额
cells.en: Participants are categorized as Full Trading Participants (PNP), Trading Participants (PN), and Settlement Participants (PL), and must set pre-trade limits for clients via the LINE system

cells.zh: 按成交总金额收取一定比例的交易所费用（Exchange Fees），费率依交易类型（常规交易/超短线日内交易）、投资者类别（个人/基金/投资俱乐部）与投资金额分档
cells.en: Exchange Fees are charged as a percentage of total traded volume, varying by trade type (regular vs. very-short-term day trades), investor category (individual/funds/investment clubs), and amount invested

cells.zh: 会员制
否
人民币（A股）；美元（B股，规模很小且趋于边缘化）
中国证券监督管理委员会
cells.en: China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC)

cells.zh: 中国证券业协会（券商层面）；交易所自身对上市公司行使一线自律监管职能
cells.en: Securities Association of China (SAC)

cells.zh: 《中华人民共和国证券法》

cells.en: Opening Call Auction (9:15-9:25)

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（14:57-15:00，普通证券适用；基金交易无独立收盘集合竞价）
cells.en: Closing Call Auction (14:57-15:00)

cells.zh: 限价申报；市价申报（仅限连续竞价阶段）
cells.en: Limit Order; Market Order (continuous auction only)

cells.zh: 百分比涨跌幅
无指数级熔断（2016年1月8日起暂停实施）
科创板设「异常波动」与「严重异常波动」两级指标并公告，不中断交易；无涨跌幅限制股票另有盘中30%/60%触发的10分钟临时停牌
T+1（股票整体）；部分品种（跨境/商品/货币/黄金ETF、权证等）实行 T+0
融资融券制度，限指定标的范围内进行
cells.en: Margin Trading and Short Selling

cells.zh: 科创板股票交易可实行做市商机制，做市商可提供双边报价
cells.en: Market Making Mechanism

cells.zh: 注册制（主板与科创板均已实行注册制）
四类强制退市（交易类、财务类、规范类、重大违法类）+ 主动退市
中国证券登记结算有限责任公司
cells.en: China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited (ChinaClear)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
会员制，会员为证券公司等持牌机构
交易经手费等，由交易参与人向交易所缴纳
0.05%（单边，卖方缴纳）
公司制但未单独上市——Eurex Deutschland本身不是被交易的上市实体，母集团Deutsche Börse Group本身是上市公司，但那是另一层
cells.en: Corporate but not separately listed — Eurex Deutschland itself is not a listed trading entity; parent Deutsche Börse Group is publicly listed, but that is a separate corporate layer

cells.zh: 否，Eurex Deutschland自身未上市
cells.en: No, Eurex Deutschland itself is not listed

cells.zh: 多币种——按标的合约计价，欧元为主，另有美元、英镑、瑞士法郎等计价的产品
cells.en: Multi-currency — denominated per underlying contract; primarily EUR, with USD/GBP/CHF-denominated products also listed

cells.zh: 黑森州最高监管机关（交易所监管机关，Exchange Supervisory Authority）——不是联邦金融监管局BaFin
cells.en: The competent highest state authority in the State of Hesse ("Exchange Supervisory Authority") — not the federal BaFin

cells.zh: 交易所理事会（Exchange Council），依据德国交易所法及黑森州交易所条例设立
cells.en: Exchange Council, established pursuant to the German Stock Exchange Act and the Exchange Regulation issued by the State of Hesse

cells.zh: 《德国交易所法》（Börsengesetz）
cells.en: German Stock Exchange Act (Börsengesetz)

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Auction），期间可继续提交订单/报价，以撮合成交量最大的价格定开盘价（Netting流程）
cells.en: Opening Auction; additional Orders and Quotes may still be entered during the auction, with the opening price determined via a netting process maximizing matched volume

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing Auction），部分品种另设盘中收盘集合竞价（intra-day Closing Auction）
cells.en: Closing Auction; some instruments also have intra-day Closing Auctions

cells.zh: 市价申报、限价申报、止损申报（Market/Limit/Stop Orders），另支持多种复合工具（跨期价差组合等）
cells.en: Market Orders, Limit Orders, Stop Orders; complex instruments (e.g. calendar spread strategies) are also supported

cells.zh: 动态/静态价格区间（Dynamic/Static Price Range），预期成交价超出区间即触发波动性中断，而非直接禁止申报的固定涨跌停
cells.en: Dynamic/static price ranges; when the next expected execution price falls outside the range, a Volatility Interruption is triggered rather than the order being flatly rejected as with a fixed daily limit

cells.zh: 区间宽度与参考价由管理董事会（Management Board）按每个衍生品逐一确定，未公开统一的百分比表（与JPX值幅制限、美股LULD的Tier分级不同，本所未见公开的统一档位表）
cells.en: The size of each price range and its reference prices are set by the Management Board per Derivative; no single published percentage table was found (unlike JPX's tiered yen bands or the U.S. LULD Tier system)

cells.zh: 无独立于波动性中断之外的全市场级熔断；波动性中断（见volatility_interruption）触发后管理董事会可扩大到同一衍生品的全部合约暂停交易，但本次未找到覆盖全市场所有产品的熔断安排
cells.en: No market-wide circuit breaker separate from the Volatility Interruption mechanism; upon a Volatility Interruption the Management Board may extend the trading halt to all Instruments of the same Derivative, but no exchange-wide halt covering all products was found in the content fetched this session

cells.zh: 波动性中断（Volatility Interruption）：预期成交价超出动态或静态价格区间即触发，中断后以集合竞价方式恢复交易（紧接的收盘集合竞价除外）
cells.en: Volatility Interruption: triggered when the next expected execution price falls outside the dynamic or static price range; trading resumes via an auction (unless immediately followed by a Closing Auction)

cells.zh: 受监管做市商制度（Regulated Market Maker）：需申请获得资格，须在至少一个衍生品品种上按月平均覆盖每日交易时段50%的时间持续提供双边报价，具体点差/报价量要求由管理董事会另行规定
cells.en: Regulated Market Maker system: admission required; must continuously enter binding two-way quotes in at least one Derivative covering 50% of daily Trading Hours on a monthly average, with specific spread/volume requirements set separately by the Management Board

cells.zh: 欧洲期货结算公司
cells.en: Eurex Clearing AG

cells.zh: 视产品而定：实物交割为默认方式（如部分利率/债券期货），管理董事会可决定排除实物交割改为现金结算
cells.en: Depends on the product: physical delivery is the default for some products (e.g. certain interest-rate/bond futures); the Management Board may rule out physical delivery in favor of cash settlement

cells.zh: 分「获准公司」（Admitted Companies）与「交易员」（Exchange Traders）两层：公司须获准参与交易所交易，个人交易员须通过资格考试（Exchange Trader Examination）后方可代表获准公司下单
cells.en: Two-tier structure: "Admitted Companies" must be admitted to exchange trading, and individual "Exchange Traders" must pass an Exchange Trader Examination before placing orders on behalf of an Admitted Company

cells.zh: 按三类收费：交易参与准入费、交易参与年费（由管理董事会确定）、交易员资格考试费；另有成交撤销/更正申请费每笔500欧元
cells.en: Three fee categories: admission fee, annual participation fee (set by the Management Board), and Exchange Trader examination fee; a separate EUR 500 fee applies per cancellation/correction application

cells.zh: 公司制（自身上市）
是（股票代码 0388.HK，即在自己的主板上市）
港元为主；2023年起推出双柜台模式，部分股票可另以人民币计价交易
cells.en: HKD; Dual Counter (HKD/RMB) since 2023

cells.zh: 证券及期货事务监察委员会
cells.en: Securities and Futures Commission (SFC)

cells.zh: 港交所本身兼具前线监管职能（对上市公司与交易参与者）
cells.en: Front-line regulation by HKEX

cells.zh: 《证券及期货条例》
cells.en: Securities and Futures Ordinance (SFO)

cells.zh: 盘前集合竞价（9:00-9:30，单一价格）
cells.en: Pre-opening Session (POS)

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价，4:00pm 起至 4:08-4:10pm 间随机收盘
cells.en: Closing Auction Session (CAS)

cells.zh: 限价盘为主；VCM 触发后冷静期内仅可在价格区间内报价
无涨跌幅限制（无 daily price limit）
无全市场熔断；个股/产品层级设波动性中断机制（官方中文全称：市場波動調節機制，简称市調機制）
cells.en: Volatility Control Mechanism (VCM)

cells.zh: 波动性中断机制（市調機制/VCM）：以5分钟前成交价为基准，触发阈值按恒生综合大型股/中型股/小型股指数成份股分组分别为±10%/±15%/±20%，触发后进入5分钟冷静期（非停牌，仅限价区间内可继续交易）
cells.en: Volatility Control Mechanism (VCM)

cells.zh: T+0（可当日回转，无 SSE 式 T+1 限制）
受监管的卖空：仅限「指定证券」、须为备兑卖空、遵守报升规则（不得低于最优卖盘价/参考价）
cells.en: Regulated Short Selling

cells.zh: 结构性产品（权证/牛熊证）、ETF、双柜台股票均设做市商制度，卖空规则中对做市商活动另有豁免安排
cells.en: Securities Market Maker / Dual Counter Market Maker

cells.zh: 披露为本制度（非注册制/核准制的简单二分，上市委员会对适合性有实质审核权）
香港中央结算有限公司
cells.en: Hong Kong Securities Clearing Company Limited (HKSCC)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场为主）
交易所参与者（Exchange Participant）制度，须为持牌法团或注册机构
0.1%（买卖双方各自缴纳，2023年11月17日起由0.13%下调）
公司制（母公司JPX由2013年东证集团与大阪证交所合并组成并上市）
cells.en: Demutualized (parent JPX formed by the 2013 merger of Tokyo Stock Exchange Group and Osaka Securities Exchange, then listed)

cells.zh: 并非TSE本身单独上市，而是母公司日本交易所集团（JPX）在TSE挂牌（2013年1月4日，当时为第一部）
cells.en: Not TSE itself; parent Japan Exchange Group (JPX) is listed on TSE (since January 4, 2013, originally on the 1st Section)

cells.zh: 日元 (JPY)
cells.en: JPY

cells.zh: 金融厅
cells.en: Financial Services Agency (FSA)

cells.zh: Japan Exchange Regulation（JPX集团内设自律监管机构，2014年由「东京证券交易所自律监管法人」更名而来）；日本证券业协会（JSDA，经纪商会员层面）
cells.en: Japan Exchange Regulation (JPX Group's self-regulatory body, renamed from Tokyo Stock Exchange Regulation in 2014); Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA, broker-member level)

cells.zh: 《金融商品交易法》
cells.en: Financial Instruments and Exchange Act

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价撮合决定开盘价，其后转为连续竞价
cells.en: Opening price determined by call auction, then continuous trading begins
Closing call auction, 3:25-3:30 p.m., executed at 3:30 p.m.

cells.zh: 市价申报、指值申报（限价申报）
cells.en: Market orders and limit orders

cells.zh: 值幅制限：按前收盘价所在区间，分37档规定绝对值幅（非百分比），如100円以下±30円……5000万円以上±1000万円
cells.en: Price limits on bids and offers: 37 tiers of absolute yen amounts (not percentages) keyed to the base price band, e.g. under 100 yen → ±30 yen ... 50,000,000 yen or more → ±10,000,000 yen

cells.zh: 见 type 字段的37档完整表；档位随基准价升高而放大，非固定比例
cells.en: See the 37-tier table in the type field; the band widens as the base price rises, not a fixed percentage

cells.zh: 无独立的全市场熔断机制（如美股MWCB）；波动控制主要通过「特別気配」（特别行情揭示）机制实现——申报价格超出值幅制限的基准价时，不直接成交，而是显示特别气配指示性价格，上午盘超出即不成交，下午盘则按值幅制限价位处理
cells.en: No separate market-wide circuit breaker (unlike the U.S. MWCB); volatility control operates primarily through the "special quote" mechanism — when an order price would exceed the price-limit band around the base price, no trade is executed at that price; instead a special indicative quote is displayed. In the morning session no transaction is effected; in the afternoon session trading is capped at the price limit

cells.zh: 同 circuit_breaker 所述的「特別気配」机制——本质是值幅制限的执行方式，而非独立的波动性中断层，与港交所VCM那种独立于涨跌停之外的冷静期机制不是同一类设计
cells.en: Same "special quote" mechanism described under circuit_breaker — it is the enforcement mechanism of the price-limit system itself, not a separate volatility-interruption layer distinct from price limits (unlike HKEX's VCM, which operates independently of any daily price limit since HKEX has none)

cells.zh: 现货股票交收前不得卖出（不可当日回转），与结算层面T+2（见 clearing.settlement_cycle）相配套
cells.en: Securities purchased may not be sold before settlement (no same-day round-trip); pairs with the T+2 settlement cycle (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 卖空须向交易所披露（标记申报），且受价格限制约束（Rule 16「卖空价格限制基准价」），类似报升规则，具体触发比例本次未能在抓取内容中确认
cells.en: Short sales must be flagged/disclosed to the Exchange and are subject to a price restriction (Rule 16, "Base Prices with Short Selling Price Restriction"), functionally similar to an uptick rule; the specific trigger percentage was not confirmed in the content fetched this session

cells.zh: 披露为本，交易所设初次上市审查，重大事项另须向金融厅报告
cells.en: Disclosure-based; the Exchange conducts initial listing examinations, with major matters also reportable to the FSA

cells.zh: T+2（2019年7月16日起施行，此前更长）
cells.en: T+2 (effective July 16, 2019; previously longer)

cells.zh: 日本证券结算公司
cells.en: Japan Securities Clearing Corporation (JSCC)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，透过JASDEC电子簿记结算，无实物交割）
cells.en: Not applicable (cash market, book-entry settlement via JASDEC, no physical delivery)

cells.zh: 交易参与者（Trading Participant）制度，须通过资格审查取得交易资格
cells.en: Trading Participant system; qualification obtained through an examination process

cells.zh: 公司制（2006年由会员制改制）
cells.en: Demutualized (2006)

cells.zh: 并非NYSE实体本身上市，而是其母公司洲际交易所（ICE）在纽交所上市（股票代码 ICE）
cells.en: Not NYSE itself; parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) is listed on NYSE

cells.zh: 美元 (USD)
cells.en: USD

cells.zh: 美国证券交易委员会
cells.en: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)

cells.zh: NYSE Regulation（交易所自身的一线监管部门）；金融业监管局（FINRA）按监管服务协议代为执行部分跨市场执法工作
cells.en: NYSE Regulation; FINRA (via Regulatory Services Agreements)

cells.zh: 《1934年证券交易法》
cells.en: Securities Exchange Act of 1934

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（9:30am），由指定做市商（DMM）主持
cells.en: Core Open Auction, facilitated by the Designated Market Maker (DMM)

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（4:00pm），3:50-4:00pm为收盘失衡期
cells.en: Closing Auction, preceded by a Closing Imbalance Period

cells.zh: 限价订单、市价订单（且有多种细分类型，如Five Best Orders Immediate or Cancel等）；具体订单类型矩阵未逐条核实
cells.en: Limit Order, Market Order (multiple sub-types)

cells.zh: 涨跌限价机制（LULD），非固定百分比/绝对值幅，而是以过去5分钟均价为基准动态计算的价格带
cells.en: Limit Up-Limit Down (LULD)

cells.zh: 按Tier 1（标普500/罗素1000/部分ETP）与Tier 2（其余NMS证券）分级设定价格带百分比，具体档位数值本次未在抓取页面中找到
cells.en: Price bands are set by Tier 1 (S&P 500 / Russell 1000 / select ETPs) vs. Tier 2 (other NMS securities); the specific percentage figures were not found in the pages fetched this session

cells.zh: 全市场熔断（Market-Wide Circuit Breaker, MWCB），基于标普500指数单日跌幅触发三级阈值：7%（一级）、13%（二级）、20%（三级）
cells.en: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker (MWCB)

cells.zh: 涨跌限价机制（LULD）本身即承担个股级波动性中断功能：价格持续处于价格带边缘会触发交易暂停
cells.en: LULD serves as the stock-level volatility interruption mechanism

cells.zh: T+0（可当日回转），与结算层面的T+1（见 clearing.settlement_cycle）是两回事
cells.en: T+0 (same-day round-trip trading allowed); distinct from the T+1 settlement cycle (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 受Regulation SHO监管，含卖空限制熔断机制（SSR）；具体触发阈值（如报升规则的百分比）本次未能在NYSE/SEC/FINRA官网核实到直接原文
cells.en: Regulated under Regulation SHO, incl. Short Sale Restriction (SSR) circuit breaker

cells.zh: 指定做市商制度（DMM）：每支股票指定一名DMM，负责在开盘、收盘及严重失衡/不稳定期间维持价格发现
cells.en: Designated Market Maker (DMM)

cells.zh: 披露为本（非注册制/核准制二分），设有量化+定性双重上市标准，由Issuer Regulation团队审核
cells.en: Disclosure-based (not a simple registration/approval binary); combines quantitative and qualitative listing standards, reviewed by the Issuer Regulation team

cells.zh: 未达持续上市定量/定性标准触发退市；具体阈值（如最低股价规则）本次未逐条核实
cells.en: Non-compliance with quantitative or qualitative continued listing standards
T+1 (effective May 28, 2024; previously T+2)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
cells.en: Not applicable (cash market; no physical/cash delivery concept)

cells.zh: 会员组织（member organization）体系，须通过NYSE Regulation合规审查
cells.en: Member organization structure; subject to NYSE Regulation compliance review

cells.zh: 做市商-吃单者模式（maker-taker）：为市场提供流动性的报单可获返佣（如每股0.0012美元量级），吃走流动性的一方付费；费率按会员机构的报价/成交量分层，逐月计算
cells.en: Maker-taker pricing model
